method.universe: v1 dataset rows with y_clean_20d True and y_excess_20d present; OOS signal dates 2023-01-02..2026-09-16, pre-OOS 2022-10-03..2022-12-30 reported separately
method.per_date: complete cases of feature, the three controls and the label; >= 100 names per date and subset; IC = Spearman(feature, label); residual IC = Spearman(residual of per-date OLS of the feature's percentile rank on the controls' percentile ranks with intercept, label); ranks recomputed inside each liquidity subset
method.aggregation: mean over dates; Newey-West t (Bartlett, 20 lags); circular 20-session moving-block bootstrap 95% percentile CI, B = 1000, seed 108 (formulas of ml/scale5y_report.py); non-contiguous date groups are bootstrapped over their own chronological sequence
method.direction: portfolio_5y.json direction_by_month: sign of the EW universe's forward 20-day return over the month's signal dates
method.prepost: OOS dates < 2026-03-01 vs >= 2026-03-01; independent block bootstraps of the two segments (seeds 108 and 109); difference = post - pre
method.reading: durable = residual IC (all names) > 0 with the 95% block-bootstrap CI excluding zero in at least 3 of the 4 calendar years 2023-2026 AND, over the whole OOS window, in both liquidity halves (cs_rank_turnover < 0.5 and >= 0.5)
method.discovery_overlap_note: Both delivery features were first identified on the pilot's 16 months (ml/data/, 2025-06-02..2026-09); 2023 and 2024 are the years that played no part in finding them.

stricter_reading_year_x_half.rule: residual IC CI above zero in at least 3 of 4 years inside EACH liquidity half (not the pre-registered rule; a robustness check of its interpretation)

deliv_pct_sma_20.text: deliv_pct_sma_20: residual IC CI above zero in 3 of 4 years (2024, 2025, 2026); illiquid half yes, liquid half yes -> PASS (durable)
